# sspi_upgrade_packages (Data Source)

Lists the upgrade packages the SSPI appliance depot currently considers eligible for appliance self-upgrade (`sspi_upgrade`).

Corresponds to `GET /sspi/upgrade/packages`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `packages` (Attributes List) List of upgrade packages eligible for appliance upgrade. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--packages))

<a id="nestedatt--packages"></a>

### Nested Schema for `packages`

Read-Only:

- `package_name` (String) Filename of the upgrade bundle (e.g. `upgrade-bundle-5.1.0.0.0.29219600.sub`).
- `package_size` (String) Human-readable size of the upgrade bundle (e.g. `4.94G`).
- `version` (String) Version contained in this upgrade package (e.g. `5.1.0.0.0.29219600`).
